crown.why: Highest virtue index: a perfect number (28 = 1+2+4+7+14) that is also harmonic, practical, and triangular, carrying the clean cultural association of a natural renewing cycle and essentially zero negative baggage.

most_virtuous_pair.why: The first amicable pair: each is exactly the sum of the others proper divisors. Friendship, made arithmetic.
